description: A shelter needs to reconstruct possible exposure chains after a contagious illness is identified in one section, including room moves, shared handling, quarantine timing, and staff contact patterns.

user_profile.persona: 38-year-old shelter operations lead handling a potential outbreak response
user_profile.context: The illness was identified quickly, but tracing contact pathways is hard because movement and staffing records are spread across systems
user_profile.communication_style: Containment-oriented and timeline-focused, wants exposure chains traced with care rather than assumptions

fact_sheet.fact: The contagious illness was identified as Feline Calicivirus (FCV) by Dr. Elena Vance on October 26, 2023.
The formal diagnosis for animal A4512 (Jasper) was logged into the ShelterPro Manager system at 11:15 AM on October 26, 2023.
Initial symptoms reported for Jasper (A4512) on October 25, 2023, were sneezing and mild ocular discharge.
The index case is a 2-year-old male domestic shorthair cat named Jasper, with animal ID A4512.
Jasper (A4512) was admitted to the Paws & Whiskers Sanctuary as a stray on October 15, 2023.
A cat named Luna, ID A4520, was housed in Cat Condo B-12, which is directly adjacent to Jasper's former condo (B-11).
A cat named Milo, ID A4509, was in Intake Kennel C-04 on October 15, 2023, directly across the aisle from Jasper's initial kennel.
On October 15, 2023, at 4:00 PM, Jasper (A4512) was placed in Intake Kennel C-03 upon arrival.
On October 18, 2023, at 2:30 PM, Jasper (A4512) was moved from Intake Kennel C-03 to Adoption Wing B, Cat Condo B-11.
On October 26, 2023, at 11:45 AM, Jasper (A4512) was moved from Cat Condo B-11 to the Isolation Ward, Room ISO-2.
The move of Jasper (A4512) on October 18 was performed by Animal Care Technician Liam Chen.
Liam Chen is an Animal Care Technician, employee ID 7845.
Maria Garcia is an Adoption Counselor, employee ID 7860.
Dr. Elena Vance is the Lead Veterinarian, employee ID 7821.
Liam Chen was the primary handler for all animals in Adoption Wing B during the 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM shift from October 22 to October 25, 2023.
Maria Garcia handled Jasper (A4512) during an adoption meet-and-greet in Visitation Room 2 on October 24, 2023, from 1:00 PM to 1:15 PM.
Dr. Elena Vance performed the physical examination of Jasper (A4512) in Exam Room 3 on October 26, 2023.
Liam Chen and Maria Garcia shared a lunch break in the staff breakroom at 12:30 PM on October 24, 2023.
The standard quarantine protocol for FCV exposure is a strict 14-day observation period in the current enclosure.
As of October 26, 2023, 4:00 PM, all 15 cats in Adoption Wing B have been placed under quarantine.
The designated cleaning agent for FCV disinfection is Rescue™ (Accelerated Hydrogen Peroxide) at a 1:16 dilution with a 10-minute contact time.
Staff entering quarantined zones must wear a dedicated gown, gloves, and shoe covers, which are to be disposed of in a biohazard bin before exiting.
Jasper (A4512) is being treated with subcutaneous fluids (100ml Lactated Ringer's solution) twice daily.
A broad-spectrum antibiotic, Clavamox (62.5 mg), is being administered orally to Jasper (A4512) every 12 hours to prevent secondary bacterial infections.
Jasper's recorded temperature on October 26 at 11:00 AM was 103.8°F (39.9°C).
Luna's (A4520) record shows she received her most recent FVRCP vaccination on September 5, 2023.
Adoption Wing B and the Intake Wing share the same HVAC air handling unit, AHU-2, which does not have HEPA filtration.
The laundry from all wings is co-mingled and washed in the main laundry facility using a high-temperature (160°F) sanitation cycle with bleach.
Food and water bowls for Adoption Wing B are washed in the central kitchen's industrial dishwasher, which has a final rinse temperature of 180°F (82°C).
Security camera footage for Adoption Wing B is stored on the 'SecureView' server at IP address 192.168.1.50 and is retained for 30 days.
Animal movement records are logged in the ShelterPro Manager system, accessible at the URL https://paws.shelterpromanager.local/records.
The staff work schedule is managed in 'WhenToWork', but zone assignments are written daily on a physical whiteboard in the staff office.
The initial alert about Jasper's symptoms was posted by Liam Chen in the Slack channel #ops-alerts at 8:05 AM on October 26, 2023.
Veterinary notes are stored in a separate module within ShelterPro Manager accessible only to users with 'Veterinary' role permissions.
